text: Right, I'll keep this as short as I can but I want a straight answer please. My granddaughter is 4 and staying wi me the now. Her temprature is 38.1, I checked it twice wi the ear thermometer. She's got the chickenpox spots all over her tummy and back and she's scratchin at them something terrible, poor wee soul. She's also got a few midgie bites on her legs from the gairden yesterday that are itchy as well, so she's no very happy wi all the itching. Other than that she's grand, eating her toast, watching her programmes, giving me cheek as usual. I've done the oatmeal bath and put the calamine on. What I want tae know is, is there anything else I should be doing for the itch and the temprature, and does she need tae be seen or will it just run its course. Her mammy will be wantin tae know if she can go tae nursery on Monday as well but I'd say no. I'm no wanting to be fobbed off, just tell me straight.
